verification.pixel_check_scope: Two pre-registered fixed cases/domain and four models; independent float64 resampling, normalization, mean, median and strict thresholds. Sampled pixel verification, not all-image pixel recomputation.

rose_reference.protocol: RoSE indices21..30, ten input images/object. Our main uses lowest-ID single image/object. Protocol comparison, not an exact reproduction.

notes.aggregation: Seeds averaged within each image metric, then image/object macro. Median is macro of within-image pixel medians; thresholds are strict pixel percentages, not percentages of objects.
notes.boundary: GT adjacent normal jump >20 degrees, radius2 dilation and GT-valid intersection; excludes silhouette unless it also meets the angular definition. Empty regions are null with coverage counts.
notes.inference_seeds: R deterministic; V/Xn image-specific CUDA noise seeds42..49. NLR default511 once per sorted input stream. Pre-registered NLR subset rerun seeds511/512/513; subset511 does not share the full-stream RNG order.
notes.real_protocol: One preselected lowest-ID light per object, not the RoSE ten-image21..30 protocol. No per-image exposure, gamma, light-intensity division or crop. uint16/65535 mapped to8bit. Official masks. Pot2 excludes73 zero-GT official-mask pixels, before scoring; no LUCES exclusions.
notes.efficiency: Shared4090,512x512,batch1,5warmups,30timings. OfficialNLR float32; ours bf16 autocast with float32 normalization. Accuracy inference ours256/NLR512. Native output-writing paths differ; not an identical-precision pure-compute comparison.
notes.labels: GSO main smooth geometry, secondary face and crease45. Arb retains BSDF normal-pass labels and its GT-valid contract. UID exclusion does not prove exhaustive cross-source geometry deduplication.
notes.uncertainty: Inference seed variation only; one training seed for R/V/Xn; not training-seed uncertainty or confidence intervals.
notes.publication: Aggregates and code only. Source images, private manifests/records, predictions, example figures, external weights and research interpretations are not distributed.
